notes_for_reviewer: Official cuni.cz faculty pages read 2026-10-06. Two English-taught 3-year bachelor programmes, each EUR 5,000 per year (the pages do not name the academic year; stored as 2026/2027). The university-wide rule is that studies in English cost between EUR 40 and 30,620 per year depending on the programme: many more programmes exist and are NOT collected. Faculty of Science (MFF): EUR 7,100 per year for non-EU students in 2026/27 (programmes not collected). Liberal Arts deadline was 2026-03-31 and the GAP exam 2026-04-25 (passed): 2027 dates not found, left empty. English requirements and application fees not on the pages.
